summary: file lookup parameters: file paths, lstrip (default false), and rstrip (default true).
questions: Does the file lookup strip trailing newlines?
How do I keep trailing whitespace from the file lookup?

answer_card.title: file lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_terms` (required): file path(s)
- `lstrip` (default false): strip leading whitespace
- `rstrip` (default **true**): strip trailing whitespace; set false to keep it
